entries.title: Why you shouldn't do what Aaron did
entries.author: Pitarou
entries.current_title: Why you shouldn't do what Aaron did
entries.excerpt: Hi, TL;DR If Swartz's death is triggering suicidal thoughts, you must understand that this will pass, and life will be worth living. After seeing the impact of Aaron Swartz's death on the Hacker News community, I am concerned about the Werther effect (the tendency of a prominent suicide to trigger other suicides). entries.title: Ask HN admins: please stop editing submission titles
entries.author: gnosis
entries.current_title: Ask HN admins: please stop editing submission titles
entries.excerpt: The widespread practice of admins changing submission titles is incredibly annoying and obnoxious. I would be more forgiving if the edited titles were actually clearer and more descriptive than the titles the submissions originally had. But much of the time they are worse. Sometimes the titles will be changed to the title the article originally had. This would be fine if the title was a good one. entries.guide_zh: 管理员改投稿标题让作者不满，希望 HN 停止这种编辑惯例。

entries.title: What we discovered about InstallMonetizer
entries.author: pg
entries.excerpt: Last week there was some controversy online about a company we funded called InstallMonetizer. IM makes software that companies can put in their Windows installers that offers other software to the user as part of the install process. It's unclear exactly how much of a right we as investors have to tell the companies we fund what to do. But on the other hand we don't like the idea that someone we funded might be doing something illicit, so we felt like we should at least inve
entries.guide_zh: 回应 InstallMonetizer 的争议，投资方介绍自己对该公司的调查。

entries.title: Implore HN: Celebrate and encourage young developers who post here

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (January 2013)
entries.author: whoishiring

Feel free to post any job that may interest HN readers from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO. Also see: "Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer?" http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=4992618

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you stop regretting?
entries.author: regretting
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you stop regretting?
entries.excerpt: Early 30's and experience debilitating regret on a daily basis, over not receiving the best education, not having excelled in any one field, not having any piqued interests as a child, missed opportunities, paths taken that cannot be reversed, and so much more. Many of those things were due to external factors, yet my mistakes still played a big part. Friends are in better places who I never saw as more hardworking or intelligent than I, but perhaps I've been deluded. Efforts
entries.guide_zh: 三十出头仍每天为教育、成就等遗憾困扰，作者想知道如何停止后悔。
